content: Yoni togiebapitaiso ꞌina mwawasa
Tuta gote ꞌenaya Elodi, tauna Galili ꞌana toloina, Yesu ꞌina guinuwa alena ꞌinonona,
ga ꞌina toguinuwao ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Nate tai nina tauna Yoni togiebapitaiso, niꞌatu ꞌaene mwawasega ꞌitoolo limana ga ꞌenega ma ina waiwai ꞌiguiguinuwa.”
Manuna lowa Elodi Yoni ꞌigiyaina ga ꞌiyonina ta deliya ꞌisaꞌuna. Ta Yoni ꞌana giyai ꞌalena nate ꞌebweu waine ꞌana esana Elodiasa, nate Elodi tasina Pilipi mwanena,
ta Elodi ꞌiagina ga ꞌiaina, ta Yoni Elodi ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “Gote nigeya bubuna boboꞌana manuna tasiyo mwanena ꞌuaina.”
Nate ꞌalena ꞌenega Elodi nuwanuwana be Yoni ꞌiloemwawasi, ta esi tomota yaudi Yoni siꞌawa palopitaena, ꞌenega Elodi ꞌimatauta ga nigeya Yoni ꞌiloeloemwawasi.
Muliyega Elodi ꞌina ꞌasiyata tubuwa ꞌana ꞌebe nuwaꞌiꞌita sagalina ꞌenaya boda siegogona, ga Elodiasa natuna mewainena boda matadiya ꞌilausa ga Elodi ꞌigiegwausowalina.
ꞌEnega Elodi gomagweine nina ꞌena ꞌiona oboboma be ꞌaene ꞌabo toꞌase nuwanuwana ꞌida ꞌebwaꞌe tuga, ta wate ꞌisawa tamatamana.
ꞌEnega sinana ꞌiona gomagweine ꞌenaya ga ꞌenega gomagweine nina Elodi ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “Nuwanuwagu Yoni togiebapitaiso bulubuluna gaeba ꞌenaya ꞌusaꞌu be ꞌuꞌebwaꞌegu.”
ꞌEnega Elodi ꞌinuwamwau sinabwana, ta tuwa tuga ꞌina sawatamatamana ꞌinuwaꞌiꞌisina, ta boda niꞌatu ꞌina ona sinonona, ꞌenega ꞌitagwala,
ta ꞌina toguinuwao deliya ꞌietunedi, ga Yoni ꞌotona siꞌupwena,
ta bulubuluna gaebaya siusena ga simeꞌena, ga gomagweine siꞌebwaꞌena. Ta gomagweine nina ꞌiꞌewena ga ꞌitauyena sinana ꞌenaya.
Ta Yoni ꞌana tomuliyao simai ga Yoni kokowana siꞌewena, ga sisaꞌu ꞌaliꞌaliyena, ta muliyega sitauya Yesu ꞌena, ga yage gete sisimanena.
Pwalu sinabwana Yesu ꞌieꞌenidi
Ta Yesu yage gete ꞌinonona, ꞌenega ꞌiapwesa ga waga ꞌigeluna ga ꞌitauya sena mwatui daitaya. Ta boda Yesu ꞌina tauya alena sinonona, ꞌenega ꞌidi ꞌasa ꞌediyega siapwesa ga ꞌedega sitauya Yesu ꞌenaya.
Ta tuta nina Yesu wagega ꞌisuya dabalaya pwalu sinabwana ꞌiꞌitedi, ga ꞌina nuwaꞌoleꞌoleyega toleꞌoasao ꞌigieboboꞌanedi.

Ta ꞌasuinuwanuwaya ꞌina tononoyao simai ga Yesu sieonena, sigwae, “ꞌInapwana, sena gete mwatui daita ta ꞌiabe ꞌiguguyoi. ꞌEnega boda getedi ꞌuda etunedi be sida ila, be ꞌadi masula sida gimwane ꞌasa selabediya ꞌediya.”
Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo sitautauya, ta ꞌomi esi masula waꞌebwaꞌedi be siꞌaꞌa.”
ꞌEnega sigwae, “Ya! ꞌAma masula nigeya yauna, nate namo beledi nima ta iyana ꞌeluwa.”
Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “Beledi be iyana nidi waꞌebwaꞌegu.”

ꞌEnega pwalu ꞌiloinedi ga pwatulaya simiyatowa, ga beledi nima ta iyana ꞌeluwa ꞌiꞌewedi, ta ꞌiꞌitatuꞌe galewaya, ga masula nidi manudi ꞌiona oboboma, ga muliyega beledi ꞌigitomwedi, ga ꞌina tononoyao ꞌiꞌebwaꞌedi ga taudi tomota ꞌediya sieguyaiyedi.
ꞌEnega maiboꞌadi siꞌai ga gamwadi ꞌipawa, ta masula tupwatupwadi siegogonedi, ga kodo tuwelo siloemaedi.
Toꞌeꞌai nidi tai dimo ꞌadi yau paibi tausani nadigega, ta wate iine be gogama yaudi nigeya sisawasawadi.
Yesu ola debanega ꞌitauya
ꞌEnega ꞌina tononoyao ꞌiloinedi be wagaya sigelu be ꞌaene sinugana mali esenaya, ta tauna ꞌaene tomota maiboꞌadi ꞌiemataluwedi be siila ꞌidi ꞌasaya.
ꞌEnega sigelu, ta Yesu pwalu ꞌietunediya, ta muliyega tauna tebweuna ꞌoyaya ꞌituꞌe sabi sidasida Yaubada ꞌena. ꞌEnega niꞌatu ꞌiboi, ta Yesu tebweuna namo ꞌimiyami.
Ta tonono nidi ꞌidi waga niꞌatu sineyena ga sidolo bwagabwagaya, ga lisu sinabwana silobena ga ꞌidi waga ꞌilobunibuni, ta wate yagila matadiyega ꞌimeema.
Ta tomwa uliulitaya Yesu ola debanega ꞌitauyama, ga ꞌina tononoyao nidi selabediya ꞌiapwesa.
Gote ꞌena ꞌina tononoyao Yesu siꞌitena ola debanega ꞌimeemai, ga simatauta sinabwana, ꞌenega sinanala, ꞌidi nuwanuwa ꞌaene welabana siꞌitena.
Ta Yesu ꞌieonedi, “Geyaꞌabo wamatamatauta. ꞌAboꞌagu tuga, ꞌimi ꞌinapwana.”
ꞌEnega Pita ꞌiona, ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, ꞌeguma onaꞌaiꞌaila ꞌoyo, ꞌueonagu be ola debanega yawawa ꞌemuya.”
Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “ꞌUmai.” ꞌEnega Pita wagega ꞌimwaꞌuta ga ola debanaya ꞌitautauya Yesu ꞌenaya.
Tuta nina ꞌitautauya yagila sinabwana ꞌiꞌitena, ga ꞌimatauta, ta olaya ꞌidalala, ga ꞌibwau, “ꞌInapwana, ꞌulemegu!”
Ta Yesu ꞌilomanini ga Pita ꞌigiyaina ta ꞌigwae, “Toemisa gidaliyo, toꞌase manuna ꞌuenuwanaluwa?”
ꞌEnega siteluwa wagaya sigelu, ta yagila ꞌipela.
Ga taudi waga ꞌana tomiyanao sibwagobwago Yesu ꞌena, ta sigwae, “Onaꞌaiꞌaila, ꞌoyo Yaubada Natuna.”
Toleꞌoasao ꞌigieboboꞌanedi sena Genesaleta ꞌena
ꞌEnega siabala sena Genesaleta ꞌenaya ga sisuya dabalaya.
Ta sena nina ꞌana tomiyanao Yesu siꞌinanena, ꞌenega ale silelewanena ꞌidi ꞌasa maiboꞌana ꞌediya ga ꞌidi toleꞌoasao maiboꞌadi simeꞌedi Yesu ꞌenaya,
ta sisidena, sigwae, “ꞌInapwana, kapekapeyana be toleꞌoasao getedi ꞌamu ꞌoama tupitupinamo sida gitoo?” Ga Yesu ꞌitagwala. ꞌEnega taudi ꞌana ꞌoama sigitoona siboboꞌana.
